💥 बॉक्स ऑफिस पर नितेश तिवारी की फिल्म Ramayana का बड़ा धमाका जारी है!
Ranbir Kapoor, Sai Pallavi और Yash की इस बहुचर्चित फिल्म ने 5 November 2026 को शानदार ग्लोबल रिलीज हासिल की थी। 🎬
फिल्म ने पहले दिन ₹ 64.85 करोड़ की ओपनिंग ली थी और रविवार शाम 7 बजे तक 4 दिनों में ₹ 200 करोड़ का आंकड़ा पार करते हुए कुल ₹ 223 करोड़ net कमाई कर ली है। 📈
रिपोर्ट्स के मुताबिक, Hindi वर्जन में फिल्म को जबरदस्त रिस्पॉन्स मिला है, हालांकि Yash के रहने के बावजूद Kannada वर्जन की रफ्तार काफी धीमी चल रही है। 🍿
पहले दिन Pathaan और Animal जैसी फिल्मों को पछाड़ने के बाद अब यह फिल्म Diwali के दिन Tiger 3 के ₹ 44.50 करोड़ के रिकॉर्ड को भी पीछे छोड़ने की तैयारी में है। 🔥
क्या आपने सिनेमाघरों में Ramayana देख ली है, आपको यह फिल्म कैसी लगी? कमेंट्स में जरूर बताएं! 👇

ctx.title: Ramayana box office collection day 4 (updated live): Diwali boost propels Ranbir Kapoor, Yash, Sai Pallavi film past  ₹200 crore
ctx.summary: Ramayana is making amends at the box office after a start that was big but not big enough for a film of its scale. The epic is directed by Nitesh Tiwari.
ctx.text:
Nitesh Tiwari’s Ramayana seems to be recovering after a good, but not great, start at the domestic box office. The most expensive Indian film ever made set a new record for a pre-Diwali release in India. But there were concerns about its earnings on the day of the festival. However, on Sunday, the film allayed all those fears to register an all-time record for Diwali
Ramayana began with houseful shows on day 1, netting ₹ 64.85 crore net in India on its opening day. The figure was low given the film’s scale, but it was still the fourth-highest opening in Bollywood history. On Friday, Ramayana fell slightly, bringing in ₹ 48 crore, but jumped up on Saturday to mint almost ₹ 70 crore net. This took its three-day domestic haul to an impressive ₹ 183 crore net. On Sunday, despite Diwali keeping footfalls low in part of the country, Ramayana had a great day. The film earned ₹ 40 crore net in India by 7 PM, taking its earnings past ₹ 200 crore in just four days. Its domestic haul now stands at a formidable ₹ 223 crore .
What is worrisome for the film is that its earnings have come largely on the back of some good performance by the Hindi version. Despite Yash’s presence as Ravana, the Kannada version has started extremely slowly. It earned just ₹ 7.50 crore on day 1 and has lacked pace since. Of the other versions, Telugu has fared well, while Malayalam and Tamil are just filling the ranks.
While the Diwali weekend has seen many big films released in theatres over the years, very few release on the day of the festival itself, choosing to maximise the days after Diwali. But Ramayana came out three days before it, which meant its biggest day - the first Sunday - falls on Diwali. It is currently tracking to beat Tiger 3’s all-time Diwali earnings record. The Salman Khan-starrer earned ₹ 44.50 crore in net box office on Diwali 2023. Ramayana is aiming for a ₹ 60+ crore day as things stand currently.
On its opening day, Ramayana beat the opening-day hauls of blockbusters such as Pathaan ( ₹ 57 crore), Animal ( ₹ 63 crore), and Drishyam 2 ( ₹ 62 crore). But it fell short of Adipurush, the previous adaptation of the epic that opened at ₹ 86.75 crore. The trend continued on the second and third days. But thanks to its extended weekend, Ramayana managed to surpass the Prabhas-starrer on day 4. Adipurush earned ₹ 237 crore net in India in its first four days. Ramayana is almost certain to cross the mark by the end of Sunday.
Produced by Namit Malhotra’s Prime Focus Studios in collaboration with DNEG and Yash’s Monster Mind Creations, Ramayana is planned as a two-part film. The film stars Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama, Sai Pallavi as Sita, Yash as Ravana, and Ravie Dubey as Lakshman. The first released worldwide on November 5, 2026, while the second part is set for Diwali 2028.

Work has led him to far off places like Japan and Jordan, as well as to the interiors of Haryana and the Indo-Pak border.
